==Parent companies==
<!-- PLEASE DO NOT LIST INTERNATIONAL CHAINS UNDER EVERY COUNTRY IN WHICH THEY OPERATE, BUT ONLY THE COUNTRY THEY WERE FOUNDED IN.-->
<!-- THIS LIST IS TO HELP PEOPLE FIND WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES. IT IS NOT A DIRECTORY OF COMPANIES. PLEASE ONLY ADD COMPANIES THAT HAVE ARTICLES (BLUE LINKS). RED LINKS OR UNLINKED NAMES WILL BE REMOVED.-->

* [[CKE Restaurants]] owns [[Carl's Jr.]] / [[Green Burrito]], and [[Hardee's]] / [[Red Burrito]] dual-branded chains.
* [[Dunkin' Brands]] (defunct 2020) owns [[Dunkin' Donuts]] and [[Baskin-Robbins]].
* [[Focus Brands]] owns [[Auntie Anne's]], [[Carvel (restaurant)|Carvel]], [[Cinnabon]], [[Moe's Southwest Grill]], and [[Schlotzsky's]].
* [[Kahala Brands]] owns [[Great Steak]].
* [[The Wendy's Company]] owns [[Wendy's]] and [[T.J. Cinnamons]]
* [[Yum! Brands]] (spun off from [[PepsiCo]] in 1997) owns [[KFC]], [[Taco Bell]], and [[Pizza Hut]] restaurants outside of China.
* [[Yum China]] owns [[KFC]], [[Taco Bell]], [[Pizza Hut]], [[East Dawning]] and [[Little Sheep]] restaurants in China.
